reason: While src/sentry/testutils/factories.py:353 checks `if client_sample_rate:` and skips `0`/`0.0`, a `client_sample_rate` of `0` or `0.0` is not valid in Sentry. Production code in src/sentry/event_manager.py:786-795 (`_derive_client_error_sampling_rate`) explicitly requires `0 < client_sample_rate <= 1` and rejects `0` as invalid (and `_get_error_weighted_times_seen` at src/sentry/event_manager.py:1563-1564 computes `int(1 / error_sample_rate)` only when `> 0`), so not setting `sample_rate` for `0`/`0.0` matches production behavior.
